snippet.title: Odd Town - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Odd Town is a retro-styled first-person adventure about a picturesque small town where charm, dark humor, and something deeply wrong live side by side.

When your car breaks down in Saint Sectaire, simple odd jobs quickly spiral into a strange investigation involving kidnapping, corruption, murder, and locals who are anything but normal.

Explore the town, earn cash, buy tools, take questionable jobs, uncover hidden places, and deal with a reactive world where people remember what you do.

Eat, drink, investigate - and try not to get arrested.
Too many times.

Join our odd community on Discord to stay up to date with development and catch some strange leaks:
https://discord.com/invite/Cxp8rzUSX5
